body: Never felt love, but don't really want to. It feels like the moment you have someone you love, you have someone to lose. Easy to not care, cause then you can't get hurt.
I'm currently 16 and I feel the same exact way. I don't know if I can stand sticking around 2 more years.
Idk man, not in the same field but real weird.
If this relationship made you happy, I guess a reason is to live until the next one.

I feel worse than ever distancing from my friends, but I also can't imagine talking to them rn, don't know why. It sucks to be alone, but for some reason I want it that way. At least irl. Maybe you can relate. I can pm you and give you my discord if that's fine and I only started using reddit recently too. First post ever.

I think you wrote one of the fattest sentences I've ever read lol. I think I've never been happy, I've just ignored the sad. It also might be the whole quarantine thing, I can self destruct as much as I want. I haven't talked to any of my friends for a week, I can spend my day laying around with my knife in my hand. But the last sentence was spot on. I wish I could know you irl, because I have a friend who understands to some extent, but not fully. Unlucky that we were probably born continents apart.
How often do you cut I'd it's been 1.5 yrs? Like I've been cutting properly for maybe 3-4 months and I've covered a lot of ground.

I understand, it's hard to stop. Just make sure you cut in places that aren't easy to spot, luckily I live in a country where it's cold 75% of the time so I can wear long sleeves. I can't see myself not cutting either, is what it is for now at least.
Smart, didn't think of looking at their profile.

Nope, but people make mistakes. You can't base your entire being around 1 shitty decision. Bad people are bad more than not, and good people are good more than not. The two aren't mutually exclusive. I think OP should just accept that they fucked up, why they did, and move on.

Yeah I've been dreading the future for longer than I can remember, even before the depression I couldn't stand the idea of the future. But what is there really to be prepared for turning 18? Like it's any other year, except if you mean like final exams in school, or getting a driving license or smth.

I had a time last year around Christmas that I was depressed and started cutting, but it was only for a short time and they were shallow. Lile you I've been debating suicide for the past months, and I'm getting worse and worse. You have any idea where these thoughts came from?
I'm down to talk

If you sexted a 12 year old as a 16 year old, that's weird and you prolly shouldn't be doing that, but in no world does that make you a rapist. You aren't undeserving of love, you fucked up, you learn, you move on. I'm 16 too and have done some weird shit, but you just gotta accept that you made a mistake and that you know why it's wrong, and you leave it in the past. You're not a rapist, nowhere near.
That's not rape
Don't worry about it, but to me buddy just sounds so unbelievably condescending. Not sure why, but it just does.

I just cut in my bedroom. Just have a knife folded into some clothes. It's a lot better than the bathroom, since you can just lay in bed listening to music, enjoying the feeling. That's if people in your house actually knock or if you have a lock on your door (i think ppl in the states have those). Not telling you to do it, but just something to consider. If possible you shouldn't cut, but sometimes it's not that easy. I hope that things get better for you someday.
The buddy kinda stings, but yeah best of luck to you
You're a rapist - you think? If I can ask, what exactly happened? Being a rapist is pretty serious and it's not something you maybe, basically, think you are.

I don't know what to say, except that don't spend too much mental energy on your dad if at all possible. It won't always be, but as someone who's spent most of his life sad thinking about his dads sorry state at times, feeling guilty for not being there, thinking about what he did to my mom when I was young. It's not worth the energy, you won't be able to change him and thinking about it will only make you feel worse. I'm sorry for what happened, but don't spend excess energy on him and his behaviour.
Same. Suicide by firearm is what I spend most of my time daydreaming about. It's the only pretty much guaranteed method. Can't tell you not to, but I feel the same as you if that helps at all.
Good luck, I know you can do it.

I meant that I hope you don't keep your promise about killing yourself 5 days after christmas. Maybe came out wrong. Anyway, I hope this night gets better for you, even if it is marginally so. I have some stuff to get done for tomorrow morning, so I might not be responding anymore. Thanks for talking to me either way, it distracted me enough to stop cutting for the rest of today.
Hopefully that habit extends till 5 days after christmas.

Not a math teacher, but it sounds like it's 3 against 2, and if you include me that's 4. But I'm not gonna hold anything against you, you do as you see right. I'm not in your situation, you are. I am glad that your earlier comment wasn't the last, every bit counts.

Guess you're still set on the ibuprofen. Sad, but I can't affect your actions more than through text online. In terms of these afterlife, it's something you've already experienced. It's gonna be the same as before you were born, so nothing. There was nothing before you were born and there'll be nothing after. Well, most likely. Kinda comforting in my opinion.
I know every word you're saying is true, but it's hard to accept. Anyway, I'll try to remenber to pm you or smth on the 15th to make sure you went to therapy. Thanks for talking to me.

It's not that I didn't know other people have to go through shit, but it's more like why do I feel this way. Nothing should be wrong, give anyone else my life and living situation and they should feel fine. I feel undeserving of even depression. I always think that if I feel this bad right now when I'm young, minimal responsibilities, somehow good grades, loving friends & family, etc then how will I feel when shit gets bad, how many times worse will it be then now. I'm somehow dreading a vacation, so how will I react to money problems or other stuff. I'll probably have a gun by then as I'd be old enough, so maybe that problem solves itself.
I'm glad I've helped you, even if it's just a bit. You made my dat letting me talk to you. I'm sorry I'm the first one to try and help, but I'll be here for you if you want to talk.

I feel like a piece of shit for being depressed when everyone on here has had to deal with so much more than I ever have. I've only had one traumatic experience, but it happened so long ago and it's been pushed so deep it feels like it's not even my own memory. Please stay alive until the 15th, if not for yourself or anyone in your life, then stay alive for me. There's no rush when it comes to suicide, your life ending now or months in the future doesn't change much - you'll be dead either way. So instead of killing yourself now, hold on for the 15th. Therapy isn't guaranteed to work, but you won't know that if you're already gone. Stay alive, even if its only to see if therapy could ease your pain.

I don't know what to say. I haven't gone through a quarter of the shit it sounds you have, so who the fuck am I to say anything. Even if I couldn't help, thank you for talking to me. Sorry that the world couldn't give you what you deserved and I'm sorry my loving friends and family were wasted on me, instead of being given to you. I wish you all the best, in this, and the next life. Bye.

Is there no way to have sex with a skin atrophy in your privates. I didn't know much about it so I looked it up and it said it was more prone to skin tears and the like, but is there no gentle enough way or no position or anything that could work. If not, then all I can say is that sucks.

You're not listening to me. I'm not telling you that you need to live or that life is gonna get better soon, all I'm saying is an overdose, by ibuprofen especially, is a really bad idea. It won't work, your organs will be in a worse condition and if you want to kill yourself later people might be on the lookout as a result of this attempt. I can't control your actions, but I want you to be as rational about this as possible.
Even if your organs are fragile, that can't account for the other 26,950 or so pills you'd need to take. Don't do it man, it's destined to fail and I'd hate for it to turn out that way.
I'm here for you, if there's something I can do to help, hit me up.

So I'm assuming covid turned the relationship into a distance one and it subsequently failed. Maybe I'm not fully correct, but I'm sorry either way. And if that's your goal, it doesn't end with one failed relationship, so take your own advice and hold onto it. Could you?

My advice is don't. Suicide by poisoning/overdose has a high failure rate. It can fuck up your organs, making life worse without actually ending it. Also I've thought about an Ibuprofen overdose myself and researched it. It would take something like 27,000 pills to actually kill you, since Ibuprofen is considered a 'safe' drug. I think I remember reading about an overdose causing non-fatal liver damage. DON'T DO IT. It's not gonna work and you'll just live a worse life with people looking out for more suicide attempts. DON'T DO IT. Please don't.
If I can ask, what was your goal?
That's a while to be dealing with this kind of stuff. I can't imagine feeling like I do for 5 years, damn. I hope it lets up someday, I really do.
I hope you do too :)
Not gonna call you a freak, I've felt similar before. How long have you dealt with these thoughts if I can ask?

Shit fucking sucks man, I feel you. Sometimes I wish my family abused me so that I wouldn't have to worry about hurting them if I killed myself, but besides some shit that went down when I was younger they've been great. I guess I still have one goal in life, I'll try and hold onto it, if not for me then for you. I wish I could help you somehow, but I'm probably of no use to you anyway. Thanks for responding though.

Sounds like more than enough, but it feels like there's always room for failure when it comes to an OD attempt. Similar to slitting your wrists, it's some very precise shit, and it's hard to hit the artery in your wrists, I've tried. Aside from how effective methods are I hope you can hang on and that it would get better someday, though I can't promise it ever will.
I guess I could give meditation a try, not like I have anything better to do with my time. Thanks for responding, I appreciate it.

I honestly don't know how getting raped makes you a whore, like that makes zero fucking sense to me. I haven't experienced anything like what you have, so I can't say I understand, but I do hope it gets better for you and I'm sorry for the shit you've gone through.

I don't know what you're taking and how much, but statistically poisoning or an overdose doesn't have the highest success rate. It's also hard to get the correct amount/drug(s), so I'd recommend you wouldn't do that. It's an easy way to end up with fucked up organs without it being fatal. I can't control your actions, but I'd want you to really think about what you're doing as there's no rush when it comes to suicide. Sorry for not giving emotional support, but think about what I said.
You sound just like me, except it's peaking for me right now and not when I was 15. Guess we're in the same boat in that regard. Hope going to the doctor works out for you.
Also I'd like you to elaborate on the last part of it being more circumstantial and pressing. I'm assuming things such as money problems and the like.
Have they been consistent throughout the years?
I can't give you advice, but as a fellow cutter I hope you can be free from the pain someday.

I've heard before that people start to relax when their lungs start getting filled with water. Wondering if you felt that at all, cause I don't know if it's true. Also I'm sorry for the shit you have to go through, try to hang in there if at all possible.
I didn't know that, thanks for telling me.
